title: 第5章 借钱第6章 是糥种
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
刘冰冰没察觉到他的异样，自顾自说：“对了，我记得你女友柳娇娇，好像也在江城这边上班？”
“你们现在怎么样了？”
“我和她已经分手了。”陈阳的声音有些干涩，忙强行压下身体的燥热。
尽量让自己看起来平静些。
“啊？你们分手了？”刘冰冰显然没料到这个答案，愣了一下。
她随即又想起自己的不适，看向刘傲菲，“妈，要不我自己开车去吧，等有事我再给你打电话。”
刘傲菲上前两步，关切说：“那也行，你路上小心点，到了医院给我报个平安。”
刘冰冰点点头。
她又看向陈阳，勉强笑了笑：“陈阳，我还有急事，就先去办了，我们回头再聊。”
说完，她就转身快步朝门口走去。
脚步有些仓促。
看着她的背影，陈阳下意识地叫住她：“冰冰。”
刘冰冰停下脚步，转过身疑惑地看着他：“还有事吗？”
陈阳张了张嘴，想说自己能治好她的病，可转念一想，两人只是普通同学，他要是贸然提出给她治胸，她肯定不会同意。
说不定还会把他当成流氓。
最终，他还是摇了摇头：“没事，我们回头聊。”
“好。”刘冰冰应了一声，推门走出去。
刘傲菲走到门口，看着刘冰冰开车驶离别墅区，才关上门。
她目光落在陈阳身上，带着一丝戏谑：“小混蛋，这么看来，上回在车上，我跟女儿通话时，你就知道我女儿是你大学同学吧？”
陈阳心里一惊，没想到她这么敏锐，这点小事都能看出来。

他也不再隐瞒，点了点头：“是。”
“难怪你躲我五天。”
刘傲菲一步步逼近他，语气带着一丝委屈，“这么看来，你还是很介意我是冰冰的……”
陈阳看着她，想起柳娇娇的背叛和马浩的嚣张，一股无名火和豁出去的念头又涌上心头。
他索性一把将刘傲菲打横抱起来：“我现在不介意了。”
刘傲菲被他突如其来的动作吓了一跳：“啊，你干什么呀？快放下我……”
陈阳低头看着她又惊慌失措，又很是娇羞的模样，嘴角勾起一抹笑，“我现在就好你这一口。”
说完，他抱着刘傲菲，大步朝着二楼她的卧室跑去。
刘傲菲吓得一路叫起来。
不知是害怕，还是兴奋，她半推半就着，却自然挣脱不出陈阳有力的臂膀。
一个多小时后，真丝大床上。
刘傲菲靠在陈阳的胸膛上，脸颊泛着红晕，长长的睫毛上还带着未褪的水汽。
眼神迷离而满足。
她指尖轻轻划过陈阳紧实的腹肌，声音带着一丝慵懒的沙哑：“年轻就是好，浑身都有使不完的劲儿，就跟驴一样。”
陈阳低头看着怀中娇憨美丽的女人，抬手轻轻抚摸着她柔顺的长发。
犹豫了片刻，他还是开口道：“菲姐，能不能借我点钱？我明天就还你。”
刘傲菲抬起头，清澈的眼眸里闪过一丝警惕，迟疑了一秒，问：“你要借多少？”
陈阳心里没底，抿了抿唇，小声说：“十万……可以吗？”
他生怕这个数额会让刘傲菲不满，毕竟十万对普通人来说不是小数目。
“行。”刘傲菲想都没想就点头，松了口气说：“把你的账号给我，我这就给你转。”
content_en:
Liu Bingbing didn't notice anything strange about him and said to herself, "By the way, I remember your girlfriend Liu Jiaojiao also works here in Jiangcheng?"
"How are you doing now?"
"She and I have broken up." Chen Yang's voice was dry and he was busy suppressing the heat in his body.
Try to look calm.
"Ah? Did you break up?" Liu Bingbing obviously didn't expect this answer and was stunned for a moment.
She then remembered her discomfort again and looked at Liu Aofei, "Mom, how about I drive there by myself, and I'll call you when something happens."
Liu Aofei took two steps forward and said with concern: "That's okay. Just be careful on the road and let me know you're safe when you get to the hospital."
Liu Bingbing nodded.
She looked at Chen Yang again and forced a smile: "Chen Yang, I have something urgent to do, so I'll go take care of it first. We'll talk later."
After saying that, she turned around and walked quickly towards the door.
The pace is a little hasty.
Looking at her back, Chen Yang subconsciously called her: "Bingbing."
Liu Bingbing stopped and turned around to look at him doubtfully: "Is there anything else?"
Chen Yang opened his mouth and wanted to say that he could cure her disease, but then he thought about it. They were just ordinary classmates. If he rashly proposed to treat her breasts, she would definitely not agree.
Maybe they'll even think of him as a gangster.
In the end, he shook his head: "It's okay, we'll talk later."
"Okay." Liu Bingbing responded, opened the door and walked out.
Liu Aofei walked to the door, watched Liu Bingbing drive away from the villa area, and then closed the door.
Her eyes fell on Chen Yang with a hint of joking: "You little bastard, it seems that when I talked to my daughter in the car last time, you knew that my daughter was your college classmate, right?"
Chen Yang was shocked. He didn't expect that she was so sharp and could see such a small thing.
He no longer concealed it and nodded: "Yes."
"No wonder you avoided me for five days."
Liu Aofei approached him step by step, with a hint of grievance in her tone, "It seems like you still mind that I am Bingbing..."
Chen Yang looked at her, thinking of Liu Jiaojiao's betrayal and Ma Hao's arrogance, and an unknown fire and the thought of risking his life came to his heart again.
He simply picked up Liu Aofei and said, "I don't mind now."
Liu Aofei was startled by his sudden movement: "Ah, what are you doing? Put me down quickly..."
Chen Yang looked down at her, looking panicked and shy at the same time. He raised a smile at the corner of his mouth and said, "I just like you now."
After saying that, he hugged Liu Aofei and ran towards her bedroom on the second floor.
Liu Aofei was so frightened that she screamed all the way.
Whether it was fear or excitement, she half pushed and half gave in, but naturally she couldn't break free from Chen Yang's strong arms.
More than an hour later, on the silk bed.
Liu Aofei leaned on Chen Yang's chest, her cheeks flushed, and her long eyelashes were still wet with moisture.
His eyes were blurred and satisfied.
Her fingertips lightly traced Chen Yang's tight abdominal muscles, and her voice was lazily hoarse: "It's good to be young. You have endless energy all over your body, just like a donkey."
Chen Yang looked down at the charming and beautiful woman in his arms, and raised his hand to gently stroke her long, silky hair.
After hesitating for a moment, he finally said: "Sister Fei, can you lend me some money? I will pay you back tomorrow."
Liu Aofei raised his head, a hint of vigilance flashed in his clear eyes. He hesitated for a second and asked, "How much do you want to borrow?"
Chen Yang felt uncertain, pursed his lips, and whispered: "One hundred thousand...is that okay?"
He was afraid that this amount would make Liu Aofei dissatisfied. After all, one hundred thousand was not a small amount for ordinary people.
"Okay." Liu Aofei nodded without thinking, breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Give me your account and I will transfer it to you right away."
